contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Parse a typed decimal number. Remove every ECMAScript whitespace character, including internal whitespace. If no dot is present, change the first comma to a dot. Accept only an optional sign followed by digits with an optional decimal point, or a decimal point followed by digits. Reject exponent notation, hexadecimal notation, empty input, and other characters by returning fallback. Do not accept a numeric prefix of invalid text.
contract.domain: Strings are Unicode text of at most 128 code points. Lone surrogate code units are excluded. Fallback is finite between -1000 and 1000. Text contains at most 20 characters; accepted decimal values are finite.

inputRoles.fallback: numeric result used only on parsing failure

contract.outputRole: parsed number or fallback, not a success flag
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

reference.source: (text, fallback) => { let normalized = text.replace(/\s/g, ''); if (!normalized.includes('.')) normalized = normalized.replace(',', '.'); return /^[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)$/.test(normalized) ? parseFloat(normalized) : fallback }

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
